MU (#3), PANW (#4) and NET (#5) are strong too, but they are not on this week's list, so the system won't buy them mid-week.
The system's simulated account is at -3.9%, your account +0.3% and the S&P +0.9%. Reaching +20% needs the cash invested in winners. Don't chase, and keep the stops.
